issue.title: sase memory init --no-commit still commits generated chezmoi home instruction files
issue.description: Observed on 2026-08-13 while implementing the approved number_agent_doc_sections plan. From the workspace checkout I ran '.venv/bin/sase memory init --no-commit' expecting render-only behavior. The command exited 0 but printed '[master 96b16784] chore: initialize sase memory'. Inspecting the repo opened via 'sase repo open chezmoi -w 0' shows commit 96b16784 in /home/bryan/.local/share/chezmoi with exactly five generated files modified: home/AGENTS.md, home/CLAUDE.md, home/GEMINI.md, home/OPENCODE.md, and home/QWEN.md. The linked workspace clone remains clean, and the hand-written files AGENTS.md, home/lib/CLAUDE.md, and home/.config/nvim/CLAUDE.md are untouched. Scope: make the memory-init chezmoi deployment path honor --no-commit by writing generated files without creating a git commit or applying/publishing, and add a regression that runs the home/chezmoi memory path with --no-commit.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ht — closed task fixed --no-commit/no-publish propagation for repo initialization sidecar publishing. This report is a separate command path: 'sase memory init --no-commit' still creates a git commit in the workspace-0 chezmoi source clone.

Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest; master 443566f7d, workspace sase_13). Verified still live in-tree, and closed on priority rather than on staleness: sase-je (src/sase/ace/restore.py:220 still passes base_name positionally while 'sase stitch create --help' shows only [-n NAME], so sase restore still fails end to end -- cheap, well-scoped fix if you want it back) and sase-ca (sase memory read generated_skills.md still carries the 'Commit Skills per Runtime' table asserting /sase_hg_commit is Gemini-only, contradicting Tier-1 Uniform Agent Runtimes; editing a memory note needs explicit owner approval anyway, so this cannot be worked unattended). Closed as low-reach: sase-jv, sase-l5 (repo resolution from a numbered workspace), sase-kb (one commit's rebase conflict in the plans repo, worktree clean afterwards), sase-l0 (memory init --no-commit blast radius), sase-lq (Grok Build double-loads AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md -- duplicate instructions, not wrong ones), sase-lp (a ~2h one-shot migration that has already been run). sase-ks is additionally superseded in substance: commit 9df15dbe2 made LaunchSelection the single consuming boundary for pooled aliases and reconciles root agent_meta.json, prompt_step_*.json, and chat metadata against the model actually invoked. Re-file any of these with a +1 if it bites during real work.
